plainText:
Old Man Swamp (Japanese: ヌマタ老人 Old Numata), also known as Mr. Swampy, is a character of the day who appeared in A Mudkip Mission. He also appeared in Ash & Pikachu.

==In animation==
Old Man Swamp runs a shelter on Dewford Island for , where he raises Mudkip from s provided to him by the Pokémon League for starting s of the Hoenn region. 

In A Mudkip Mission, he was initially furious to see that and had trespassed onto his property. Soon everything was straightened out when Max explained that saved a baby Mudkip. Brock later explained to him that another, older, was responsible for rescuing the baby Mudkip. Swampy then informed the group that the older Mudkip was actually a wild Mudkip, who'd befriended the Mudkip he raised and acted as their self-appointed guardian. Afterwards, Swampy invited the group over to his home and allowed them to watch a Mudkip hatch from an Egg.

 , who had accidentally stumbled onto Swampy's property were unaware of the valuable Mudkip the he was caring for. However this all changed when Old Man Swamp, who has a tendency of giving out too much information, revealed that he raised Mudkip and he explained that breaking the dam would flood the area and the Mudkip would have nowhere to live. James promptly called on to destroy the dam wall, and soon the Mudkip were threatened by the raging flood waters. Brock, and the large Mudkip went onto rescue all of the Mudkip hatchlings. Afterwards, Team rocket revealed their mechanized Mudkip maiden and scooped up all of the Mudkip. Brock again intervened, having Lotad and the large Mudkip soak the ground to trap the robot in the muddy soil before sent the Rocket trio blasting off with a .

When Old Man Swamp saw how Brock and Mudkip worked together to save the baby Mudkip and stop Team Rocket, he asked Brock to take Mudkip with him as it was going to be too lonely once all of the other Mudkip were given to their new s. Both Brock and Mudkip happily agreed.

Old Man Swamp bears a great resemblance to the Pokémon he takes care of.
